body:
Hi Armando,

I was looking at your website this week, and one line stuck with me. Your own description offers "any remodeling service, paint job, floor service, whatever it may be". You and I both know your work is better than that sentence. You paint, you remodel kitchens and bathrooms, you do floors, decks and siding, and your customers rate you 4.7 stars on Google. But the site lumps all of it into a couple of vague paragraphs, shows none of that proof, and the only way to start a free estimate is to pick up the phone.

So I rebuilt your homepage properly, and it is attached to this email as a PDF. Painting and remodeling each get their own clear sections, your family-owned story and your 11 plus years of experience sit up front, your Google rating is on the page where it belongs, and a free estimate is one tap away.

Painting and home sites are a big part of my work. I built elkhornpainting.com for a painting company that needed its services presented cleanly. I also built sennesdesignbuild.com, where the remodeling work had to look as good as it turned out.

If you like it, I can put it on your real domain and build out the rest. If not, keep the PDF as free ideas, no hard feelings.

Best,
Hassan
name: A & A Painting and Remodeling, LLC
subject: 🎨 Armando, your website calls your work "whatever it may be"
